'''IM-2M''' was an [[IM series]] [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] manufactured by [[Droid Security Systems]] and stationed in the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] terminal of [[Spaceport THX1138]]<ref name="The Adventures Continue" /> by about the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours">{{SW|url=news/convenient-daily-departures-the-history-of-star-tours|text=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of ''Star Tours''|int=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours|nolive=1}}</ref> It had multiple [[Color/Legends|black]], red, and white sensors, as well as blue and silver plating.<ref name="The Adventures Continue" />

==Behind the scenes==
IM-2M was created for [[Tokyo Disneyland]]'s [[Wikipedia:Simulator ride|simulator ride]] [[Wikipedia:Amusement park|theme park]] attraction ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'', which opened on [[May 7]], [[2013]]. It was identified by a container located in the ride's queue, where it hung from the ceiling on a fixture.<ref name="The Adventures Continue" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' {{1st}} {{C|Tokyo only}}
